top_categories.workout_context: Race-pace efforts that mimic Gran Fondo Siete Lagos' demands. Pacing, fueling, and tactical decisions under fatigue. Practice the race before November.

Road-specific control matters at Gran Fondo Siete Lagos. Practice on rolling mountain roads: use smooth gear and cadence changes, accelerate deliberately out of corners, and settle quickly back into sustainable power for 68 miles.
When someone attacks on rolling mountain roads, you have 10 seconds to respond or you're off the back. This builds that response.
72ft/mi signals a climbing-heavy course. Sustained sub-threshold and threshold work builds the steady power needed without turning the opening climb into the day’s hardest effort.
At Gran Fondo Siete Lagos, changes in grade or pace can lift effort above threshold before it settles again. Over-unders train that transition while you keep riding.
68 miles on rolling mountain roads burns energy faster than the distance suggests. Train the fade resistance now.
88–92% FTP is where you'll spend the hardest sustained miles of Gran Fondo Siete Lagos. Train it until it feels boring.
Brief efforts above sustainable power can come from grade changes, positioning, or closing a gap at Gran Fondo Siete Lagos. Train them without letting those efforts derail the longer pacing plan.
Steeper ramps, positioning, or pace changes on rolling mountain roads can demand short hard efforts. Practice them without compromising the sustained work that defines the course.
Varied gradients on rolling mountain roads demand climbing versatility. Sit the shallow stuff, stand the steep stuff, switch without thinking.
Endurance with intensity spikes baked in. Exactly what 4,921ft of climbing on rolling mountain roads does to your power file on race day.
Double-threshold training builds sustained power with less fatigue. More FTP per hour of training.

race_overlay.nutrition: Use training to rehearse an eating and drinking plan for Gran Fondo Siete Lagos' 68 miles. Start early and use products you tolerate. The organizer has not published a reliable resupply plan, so rehearse a self-sufficient carry and revise it when the rider document is released.
race_overlay.altitude: Altitude may change sustainable power and recovery at Gran Fondo Siete Lagos. Use conservative pacing and test any travel strategy before the event.
race_overlay.terrain: The course profile at Gran Fondo Siete Lagos rewards specific practice. Include regular rides on rolling mountain roads to build confidence.

pack_summary: This 10-workout pack focuses on Race Simulation, Road Specific, and VO2max to prepare you for 68 miles of rolling mountain roads in Villa La Angostura ↔ San Martín de los Andes, Neuquén, Argentina.
